description: Older houses rarely fail all at once. Anthony House Check explains what starts aging inside homes, why certain decades have characteristic problems, what warning signs are worth noticing, and what inspectors and tradespeople may look at more closely. Anthony Russo covers electrical panels, plumbing, drainage, roofs, windows, basements, insulation, water damage, previous-owner alterations and more. Not DIY repair advice—just clear explanations that help homeowners understand what may be happening behind the walls.
